_about: Task definitions used by llmbench/serialize.py, the LLM scripts and the ML scripts. Field order and key text come from naming/<task>_keys.csv (position = serialization order).

warfarin.instruction: Predict the warfarin dose (mg) that will be prescribed at discharge, based on the patient's clinical information at admission.
warfarin.naming_note: The original warfarin field names are already descriptive, so there is no separate descriptive condition.
warfarin.cleaning_note: Implausible values are set to missing before both models: 'Unknown' in the LLM input, NaN for XGBoost. The seven medication fields hold the prescribed dose and are 0 when not prescribed (filled when the split tables are built).

mace.instruction: Will the patient experience a major adverse cardiac event—all-cause death, recurrent myocardial infarction, or repeat coronary revascularization (PCI or CABG)—within one year after discharge?
mace.naming_note: descriptive = the six echocardiography fields spelled out (all other names unchanged); identifier = V1..V34 in serialization order.
mace.cohort_note: Final cohort definition (see README): label = all-cause death, recurrent MI, or repeat revascularization (therapeutic PCI or CABG) within one year after discharge; index discharge restricted so that the full one-year window is observed; in-hospital moribund discharges excluded; age in completed years at admission. Procedure flags (CABG, CAG+PTCA(balloon 1vessel), Successful) are 0 when absent.

mortality.instruction: Predict whether the following patient with a hematologic malignancy who underwent allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation will be alive or dead five years after transplantation. Answer 'alive' or 'dead'.
mortality.naming_note: 50 variables = recipient age at transplantation (serialized first as 'Age:<int>') + 49 original variables. descriptive = full names (standard abbreviations HLA/CMV/WBC/RBC/HCT-CI kept; four uncertain codes kept); identifier = V1..V50 (Age = V1).
mortality.ml_features: all 50 key-map columns; the 5 ml_numeric_columns are numeric, the other 45 categorical
mortality.sensitivity_49_variables: Supplementary analysis without recipient age: scripts/make_jsonl.py --exclude age_at_hct (max_seq 1024).
